name: locate
description: Searches a database of every path on the system instead of walking the disk: it is much faster than find, but the database is only updated about once a day. A recently created file may therefore be missing: run sudo updatedb to refresh the database. Depending on the distribution, the command comes from plocate or mlocate.

options.description: Prints only the number of results.
Searches only the file name, not the whole path.
Shows only files that still exist.
Treats the pattern as a regular expression.

arguments.name: PATTERN
arguments.description: Text to look for in paths. Without a wildcard, it just has to appear anywhere in the path.

examples.explanation: The first 5 files whose path contains “readme”, whatever the case.
Counts the JPEG images on the system.
